title: Concept Explainer — Overview and definition
body: Public edition. Public tool knowledge, fact-checked reference. Explains complicated concepts using concrete examples and analogies. The Concept Explainer explains complicated concepts using concrete examples. It takes an abstract idea, gives a plain definition, walks through two or three real examples, offers an analogy the student already understands, and then tests the explanation with a simple check question. The explanation stays anchored to the course definition so the student learns it correctly.
capabilities: Define abstract concepts in plain language
Illustrate with two or more concrete examples
Offer familiar analogies for hard ideas
Check understanding with a simple test question
Anchor explanations to the official course definition
